candidate_observations.address: B&M, 447-457 Wimborne Road, Winton, Bournemouth, Dorset, BH9 2AN
observed_facts: B & M Retail Limited, company 01357507, is active and has a ten-year lease from 10 November 2025 at £130,000, subject to a tenant break on 9 November 2030.
JM Gyms Limited trades as Snap Fitness under a fifteen-year lease from 30 September 2025 at a contracted £87,250, with a tenant break on 30 September 2036.
The gym side letter reduces its effective rent to £77,250 if membership falls below 2,000.
The £247,250 headline includes a £30,000 basement-car-park licence that expires on 30 November 2028 or on three months notice by either party.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The headline was not represented as one secure lease. The licence fee was separated from occupational rent, rent-free seller allowances were not treated as tenant payments and B&M's general charges were not treated as property default.

candidate_observations.address: 3, 5 & 5a Church Street, Sheffield, South Yorkshire, S1 1HF
candidate_observations.status: Sold Prior; price unpublished; conditional sale
observed_facts: The vacant Grade II listed former bank provides approximately 11,320 square feet across basement, ground and three upper floors.
The property is recorded as Sold Prior without a published price.
The sale is conditional and subject to confirmation by the seller.
Alternative residential or mixed-use potential remains subject to planning.
candidate_observations.guardrail: No sale price, rent, unconditional completion, planning permission or development value was inferred.

observed_facts: The vacant freehold former bank sold for £325,000.
The ground and first floors provide approximately 1,920 square feet with seven rear parking spaces.
The building was formerly let to Halifax at £40,000, but the current tenancy table records vacant possession.
Reletting or change-of-use potential remains subject to consents.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The expired £40,000 historic rent was not treated as current income, and no future rent, consent or development value was inferred.

candidate_observations.address: The Arcade, Harpur Street and High Street, Bedford, Bedfordshire, MK40 1NS
observed_facts: The 44-unit covered shopping arcade sold for £2,605,000 and is stated to be 86% let.
The £418,090 headline is accompanied by six units still to be let.
The tenancy schedule contains multiple tenant break dates and one unit where only heads of terms for a new three-year lease had been agreed.
Several individual leases have near-term breaks or expiries, so the total is not one long-dated covenant.
candidate_observations.guardrail: Vacant units received no rent, agreed heads of terms were not treated as a completed lease and the headline was not represented as one secure tenant covenant.

candidate_observations.address: 150-152 Clapham High Street, Clapham, London, SW4 7UH
observed_facts: PLK Investment 1 Limited, company 13463102, is active and pays £100,000 under a fifteen-year restaurant lease from 25 November 2024.
The upper accommodation comprises two refurbished flats containing ten en-suite rooms.
The residential rooms are separately occupied under one-year ASTs, rather than the restaurant covenant.
The £264,100 headline therefore mixes £100,000 corporate restaurant rent with £164,100 of short residential AST income.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The AST income was not presented as long-dated corporate income, and no withdrawal price or renewal beyond the stated AST terms was inferred.

observed_facts: The former bank sold for £285,000 under a sale expressly conditional on seller confirmation.
Most of the 9,017-square-foot property is vacant.
A separately held second-floor area produces only £100 under a 125-year lease from 14 July 2010.
That ground rent rises to £150 on 14 July 2035 and then by £50 every 25 years.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £100 ground rent was not represented as occupational income, vacant space received no rent and conditional status was not promoted to unconditional completion.

candidate_observations.address: Barton Business Park, 2a Barton Hill Road, Torquay, TQ2 8JH
observed_facts: The twelve-unit business park is stated to produce £49,900 and was Sold Prior without a published price.
The estate is occupied by five tenants and Unit G is vacant.
Unit F pays £7,500 while holding over, and Units I, H and L pay £12,100 while holding over.
Redevelopment potential remains subject to necessary consents.
candidate_observations.guardrail: Holding-over rents were not treated as long-dated contracted income, the vacant unit received no rent and no sale price or redevelopment value was inferred.

candidate_observations.address: Townley House, Kingsway, Burnley, Lancashire, BB11 1AA
observed_facts: The office property sold for £490,000.
The Department of Health occupied only the ground floor at £30,000 under a five-year lease from 1 April 2021, which expired after the March auction period.
The first, second and basement floors were offered with vacant possession.
Burnley Borough Council granted planning permission on 26 January 2026 under PAD/2025/0623 to convert the first and second floors into twelve apartments.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The expired exposed office lease was not treated as continuing current income. Planning permission was recorded only for the stated floors and scheme; no completed conversion or residential value was inferred.
